items.title: Cohomology of a colimit of sheaves over a colimit of sites as the colimit of the cohomologies
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the cohomology of the colimit sheaf over the colimit site with the colimit of the cohomologies at the stages, for every degree (statement lines 2904-2914, whose set-up is fixed by the companion statement delivered as a context span from lines 2854-2875). The proof disposes of degree zero by the corresponding statement on global sections (proof lines 2916-2917), then embeds the system into injective sheaves and reduces to showing the vanishing of the cohomology of the colimit sheaf in positive degrees (proof lines 2919-2925), and finally computes the Cech complex of that sheaf as a filtered colimit of the Cech complexes at the stages, which are acyclic, so that acyclicity of filtered colimits finishes the proof (proof lines 2927-2943). The non-formal content is the identification of the Cech complexes through the stages. The claim is H2: three steps, each written out.
